name: remediate-agent-harness
job: Remediate an agent harness with measured deltas: baseline, countermetrics, promotion threshold, and failure modes.

inScope: Defining the recurring outcome, baseline, and evidence quality
Tracing behavior through the whole agent system
Choosing the smallest intervention at the owning layer
Comparing outcome, failures, cost, and transfer; promoting, revising, or reverting
outOfScope: Another reminder without a tested system change
Review or delivery left open to observe indefinite improvement

inputs: Recurring behavior, impact, population, and baseline rate
System map: objective, instruction, skills, context, model, tools, permissions, evaluator
outputs: Learning Change Record with exact candidate and mechanism
Promote, revise, or revert verdict with rollback and recurrence signal

data: held-out task set or replay corpus
permissions: install or deployment boundary for the changed artifact

failureSemantics: Improvements that merely move the failure or overfit observed examples are rejected; the prompt is never assumed to be the cause without tracing; promotion happens against the frozen threshold and monitoring continues afterward.

outcome.observable: A Learning Change Record where the intervention is deployed at the owning layer, measured against a frozen baseline with countermetrics and critical failures, and promoted, revised, or reverted with rollback and a monitored recurrence signal.
